notes.title: New Ship and a save bugfix
notes.content:
Hi Aquanauts!

This is kind of a bonus update to the game. We just added a new ship! Check it out in your base ;)

ALSO very important bugfix connected to corrupted saves. If you have been naming your saves with just numbers, like "1","2" etc. you might have experienced a bug. Not only saves were corrupted, but there was a significant drop of FPS and also a lot of weird letters in the background of the save menu. NOW IT IS FIXED!

However, if your files were corrupted, we need to manually change them or delete them. Please head to our Discord and find Maciej to help you with it. Here is the instruction that you can also find on Discord:

[i]If your saves are corrupted you have two choices to fix it:
A) If you don't care about your saves, you can delete the "Stardiver" folder in the following location: %APPDATA%..\LocalLow\GreenPlanetGames\
     WARNING: this will remove all your existing saves!

B) On Discord, you can send me the packed "Stardiver" folder from the same location: %APPDATA%..\LocalLow\GreenPlanetGames\

I can manually change the content of the files and send it back to you. There is a fairly big chance that I'll be able to fix the corrupted save files for you. But it may not fix 100% of them and it may not work in specific cases.[/i]

Sorry for the problem and thank you for your understanding. This is already fixed in the game and won't happen in the future (from now on, you can even name your saves "1", "2" etc.).

notes.title: Stardiver reimagined! Final Update, Demo Available, Lower Price, and a Big Sale!
notes.content:
[b]Hi Aquanauts![/b]

Stardiver reimagined => a day we want to shift your perspective on our indie game and offer you a new demo to try the game out, a lower price, a biggest 50% sale yet, and a new trailer to get in the Stardiver's adventure and mystery vibe! But let's sort things out in a nice and structured manner :)


[b]Stardiver's new trailer first![/b]
[previewyoutube=hJi9fE1jUzg;full][/previewyoutube]



[h2]1. Stardiver, what is it?[/h2]
Sci-fi adventure with some action and exploration activities. Think of a Firewatch but with shooting and entirely underwater! We would like to change your perspective on what the game is and who we are as a team. Stardiver is an indie game made by 3 persons (now reduced to just 2 brothers making games together ;)) with a lot of help from outsourcing so we are very grateful to all the great artists that made the game possible! We hope that us being transparent will also help you to decide if the game is a good fit for you as a player.

[h2]2. Demo available![/h2]
It is simple - now everyone can try the game before buying. We've worked on a demo simultanously with the Final Update so it is the very updated version of the game.

[h2]3. Lowered price and the biggest sale yet (50%). And... why we do it?[/h2]
In the vibe of being fully transparent we wanted to lower the price to fit who we are - a small indie team of two brothers. It is an indie game so we came to conclusion that the price should be on indie level too - it was already pretty low to be honest but maybe it wasn't reflecting our small team enough. Now it is.

Alongside, we are launching the biggest sale yet! Why? Because despite all that changes that we made to the game presentation, improvements etc., we are aware that it is not enough to get out from MIXED to POSITIVE review score. That is obviously our goal and we believe that the game deserves it. Financially, it probably won't be good for us, but right now what matters the most is to deliver the game to new players, make a sort of redemption so to speak with this final update. And also important is to celebrate the half year of post-release updates and small patches that happened in that timespan! The game is in the best shape ever and we are sure that it is a very solid indie title for everyone seeking an adventure - and now we wish YOU to believe in it too and try Stardiver yourself!

[h2]4. Final Update.[/h2]
Last but not least - what has changed. The game update brings a lot of fixes and also a portion of a content - a new ship to try!
Since the release we have fixed every single issue from steam reviews, added new content, new settings, and a lot of improvements. It is a good time to try the game ;)

It probably isn't so important to you, but we also changed screenshots and a game description to better match what the game really is. We leave you with a feature list so you can decide if the game is for you before downloading a demo or grabbing a game on the current sale:

[list]
    [*] stunning underwater world

    [*] sci-fi story with relevant topics such as AI and climate change

    [*] free-roaming environment

    [*] both 3rd person and cockpit view

    [*] 1st person swimming outside the ship

    [*] activities from varius game genres: shooting, upgrading the ship, crafting, mining resources, gathering useful items, collecting clues about the planet, boss battles

    [*] 20 missions

    [*] 30 km2 world with beautiful, atmospheric, color-based areas

    [*] over 800 lines of dialogue

    [*] 77 objects to collect and read about

    [*] 35 achievements to unlock

    [*] screenshot mode 

[/list]

[i]
Best wishes,
Green Planet Games team[/i]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1599070/Stardiver/

notes.title: Update #2
notes.content:
[h1]Hi Aquanauts![/h1]

Today we released a second bigger update for Stardiver. It addresses a lot of your feedback and enhances the gameplay in few places. If you are interested in the game further development and want to help in it by giving us feedback, please join our Discord server here:
[url=https://discord.gg/aPJv62zjTW]https://discord.gg/aPJv62zjTW[/url]

[h2]What’s new?[/h2]

First of all, we have a first free content update for you:

[olist]
[*]New ship to build in the base!
[*]Two new rare plants added for all the collecting fans out there :)
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374028/c3ed3b4693dcf89add26f4ff311ec0f789be66d9.png[/img]

Other important things are FOV sliders for both a cockpit view, and a swimming in first person view. You can now adjust them to your liking. [b]It should help especially for those of you who are getting motion sickness easily.[/b]


[h2]Complete list of improvements and bugfixes[/h2]

[list]
[*][new] New ship to build in the base!
[*][new] Two new rare plants added for all the collecting fans out there :)
[*][new] Deadzones added for the gamepad to prevent accidental dodges/dashes
[*][new] FOV slider setting for the cockpit view
[*][new] FOV slider setting for the swimming in first person view
[*][new] Screenshot mode button added to the menu for easier access
[*][new] Displaying resources names on hovering them in the base

[*][changed] A part of a large mine removed from one of the chests - could lead to bugs
[*][changed] Target system added to objects available to scanning after the fight with the mech
[*][changed] Now you can change a difficulty level to Legendary in the settings dropdown (of course, if you have previously finished the game at least once)
[*][changed] Wider cave in the mining-tool mission
[*][changed] Dialogues in the mission 20 now makes more sense
[*][changed] Base ship’s speed slightly increased
[*][changed] Changed behaviour of a generator in the mission 13 to the standard one
[*][changed] Caves are now more water-like and a little bit darker

[*][bugfix] When changing bindings you can now click with the mouse and change with the gamepad
[*][bugfix] Returning info after leaving a cruise mode
[*][bugfix] Lack of instructions after defeating Nosozaur
[*][bugfix] An engine sound reenable itself after leaving the base (even when disable engine sound option selected in settings)
[*][bugfix] A billboards in the game now correctly break into smaller pieces after shooting it with the rocket weapons
[*][bugfix] Unwanted control changes to gamepad (because lack of deadzone)
[*][bugfix] Very quiet music while fighting Medusaur
[*][bugfix] Sera_phine (AI voice in the mission 20) is too quiet
[*][bugfix] After leaving the base there is no ship for a while if a cockpit view is enabled
[*][bugfix] Two yellow pointers instead of one if you leave the ship from a cockpit view
[*][bugfix] No ship icon on the minimap after leaving the ship (a bug connected to a cockpit view only)
[*][bugfix] Water settings are now properly reflected in the cockpit view of the first ship
[*][bugfix] Opening a screenshot mode during tutorial breaking the intended behaviour of the game
[*][bugfix] Ship auto-moving a little bit after the second cutscene
[/list]


This second update nicely wraps up the initial period of all the improvements and fixes you wanted us to do since the release. Thanks for pointing them out, the game is certainly better now! We also introduced all the changes we had in our minds for the past months. That led to a game state that we are very satisfied with. We hope everyone will enjoy the game from now on 🙂


[i]Best wishes,
Green Planet Games team[/i]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1599070/Stardiver/

notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
[h1]Hi Aquanauts![/h1]

Today we released a bigger update for Stardiver. It addresses a lot of your feedback and enhances the gameplay in few places. If you are interested in the game further development and want to help in it by giving us feedback, please join our Discord server here:
[url=https://discord.gg/aPJv62zjTW]https://discord.gg/aPJv62zjTW[/url]

[h2]What’s new?[/h2]

We introduce the objective target system. We are very curious about your opinion on that. It is a simple quality-of-life feature that was expected by some players, especially new ones. It shows a current objective position as a target icon in a game world. It will be very useful for finding cave entrances as many of you told us that it was too hard (we admit that we hid the entrances too much).

Check out the gif below. There is an icon suggesting where you should find a mission objective. It is visible through rocks etc. and shows how far the objective is.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374028/eb9b6626fcb2b8caa9e57049f6764be9e29acccc.gif[/img]

[h2]What’s changed?[/h2]

We changed a lot in the game but there are a few things we’d like to mention here for your attention:

[olist]
[*]You can upgrade the ship much sooner, only after 3rd mission.
[*]A lot of changes in the tutorial according to your feedback (we didn’t thoroughly change it yet though).
[*]Auto-Roll system is now moved to the game settings.
[/olist]
[b]The Auto-Roll change may affect your gamestyle.[/b] We moved it to game settings because new players stuck with it set to OFF after the tutorial and it was causing a lot of confusion (check out youtube gameplays with ships flying half-turned all the time ;p). However, some of you were using the “X” key to setting it ON/OFF while playing - that is no longer possible. Please let us know on Discord if this is something you would want to get back. If so, we will work it out somehow.


[h2]List of all improvements and bugfixes[/h2]

[list]
[*][new] Displaying “Press F to land” at the center of the screen when on base’s landing point
[*][new] Cave entrances in missions are marked by target icon now
[*][new] Added an objective target system (target icons) to various places in missions
[*][new] Possibility to turn off more visual effects
[*][new] Possibility to change screen mode in settings (windowed, fullscreen exclusive and more)

[*][changed] Swimming outside the ship is more steady (less animation, slower movement, etc.)
[*][changed] Crystals in caves are now bigger, finding them is easier
[*][changed] You can use all buildings in the base sooner (upgrade or change your ship sooner)
[*][changed] Auto-Roll/auto-leveling moved to game settings (previously at “X” key on keyboard)
[*][changed] Less fish in the first fight
[*][changed] Tutorial buttons marked when already used (more info on what is already completed)
[*][changed] Other tutorial improvements like dialogue changes, removing some steps etc.
[*][changed] Sea currents removed from the starting area (created a lot of confusion)
[*][changed] Smaller FOV in cockpit camera (=less motion sickness)
[*][changed] Scanning area is now bigger for easier object scanning
[*][changed] Improved control of the quest view (completed or active)
[*][changed] Minor various cutscenes improvements

[*][bugfix] ESC not working
[*][bugfix] Item icon from inventory staying on cursor after closing the inventory
[*][bugfix] Text overlapping in the main menu
[*][bugfix] Save errors due to unsupported characters
[*][bugfix] Collecting new items when inventory is full sometimes causes items disappearing
[*][bugfix] Crafting causing item loss sometimes
[*][bugfix] Collecting mini-mine tool blocking progress in the mission 3
[*][bugfix] Rare bug with cutting out part of a dialogue in the mission 3
[*][bugfix] Smoother camera action in the first cutscene
[*][bugfix] Smoother camera action in the second (base introduction) cutscene 
[*][bugfix] FOV unwanted change when closing a chest while swimming outside the ship
[*][bugfix] Rare problem with dash not working after the fight with Nosozaur
[*][bugfix] Mission 14 starting too soon in some specific cases
[/list]


We will continue to work on the game so you can expect more changes in the future. Thank you for playing the game! We know that many of you are enjoying it and that makes us very happy. We hope that changes and fixes described above will improve the experience for everyone, existing and new players of Stardiver 🙂


[i]Best wishes,
Green Planet Games team[/i]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1599070/Stardiver/

notes.title: Game's name is changing to Stardiver!
notes.content:
After a while and discussions with our audience, we decided to change the game's name to Stardiver, which better fits the game. In the coming days (or weeks), you can expect to see the new name on Steam and Discord.

Meanwhile, we present to you two of the three ships that you can play in the game, each with its own statistics and interior. The Galaxy is a default ship ready to tackle every task, very forgiving with steering. The second one - Harpo - is designed for low-tempo missions where you need to survive a strong enemy attack.

notes.title: Underwater Space devlog #03: Caves, Demo upcoming
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374028/6e569326325fca3d8487169e5c47a6b8bdb52787.png[/img]

[b]Hello Aquanauts![/b]

Here we are with a bunch of new stuff after being quiet for a while. Why so quiet? Because we were busy creating fundamental systems and functionalities of Underwater Space which is not very entertainable to show. Mostly programming things like better ship collisions, proper base building system, refining the inventory, and lately implementing the quest and dialogue system (very happy about it, see the top right corner of a screenshot below! ːsteamthumbsupː ). It means we are very close to have every fundamental pieces of the game ready.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374028/ee83d4d844aaaa5cfcb31757189f26281878b887.png[/img]

But having all the systems go doesn't mean for the game development to be finished. We are constantly working on underwater world to be interesting place with many secrets to discover and mysteries about old world to be learned. Throughout the development we really shifted our focus towards exploration aspect of the game as this is what you guys want - to feel the unknown depths and a sense of checking out every corner to get familiar with the Earth of the future.


[h1]Caves[/h1]

The most prominent example of exploration in Underwater Space are caves. At the beginning we thought that they should only be visited without a ship. Looking for an entrance and then diving into the water to fit between rocks feels very adventurous. And so rewarding when you finally get inside the cave! Just take a look at the screenshots and a gif animation below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374028/5eda929c68ff02c14c7c8c21693a02c604ff86b9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374028/99b052964b2967eb37c25b804853c391730fe042.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374028/c07d9af3edaacb508e19e5ec639301ed8cb2f889.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374028/08decc16804499f943d385d069d690357cdf80ec.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374028/7b392c7ed750c457e2da1a852bdf3bd7b278bd48.gif[/img]

But what we discovered lately is that flying inside a very big caves using your ship is very VERY cool! We just cannot ommit that in our game. Once we figured out how to fit these giant caves into our world we knew that it is worth to put some more effort and time in the development and add some of them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374028/89291d3b9b54a5c0249235dc455457d36dcac8aa.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374028/8d55a9981612a8c831a4728ae47d513b2e211eb0.png[/img]


With all that being said - we are getting closer to releasing the game but we are not close enough to celebrate. However, we have something to announce to not leave you with no dates:

[u][b]The demo comes to Steam this year! That's 100% sure.[/b][/u]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1599070/Underwater_Space/


I hope you are safe and ready for some swimming this year. I certainly am! Bye for now :)

notes.title: Underwater Space devlog #02
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374028/5d61459b33a4dcf6db8f7ce4218e8227827f89b3.png[/img]

[b]Aquanauts…[/b]
The thin wall between our world and the ancient secrets hidden in the deepest parts of the ocean has always been fragile. Not long after the Big Flood the wall has fallen apart and known waters across the globe have mixed up with those deeps. What does it mean for us? That the old Energy is now around us and the creatures we see may disturb what we thought about life. Not all of it is capable of good and evil. Some of it is filled with power, possessed by it. And that’s exactly what is standing in our way right now. In the form of aggressive fishes, shining weirdly through the water. In the form of giant monsters still sleeping just below us. But when you hear the cracking rocks and the unbearable scream you just know one thing - the sleeper has awakened!

[previewyoutube=oc05pCVBzEQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Today we want to introduce you to the main concept of Underwater Space. As you may have anticipated, the game will be filled with the mystery of the deeps. The greatest mystery of it all is the old Energy released to the world when the whole Earth was flooded. It came together with lifeforms possessed by it. Some of them are strong enough to keep their power for themselves and still decide about their fate. But most of them turned out to aggressive creatures willing to use the power to destroy everything that is unknown for them. And what is the weirdest, unknown thing for someone living in the deeps for centuries? Yes, mankind. You will be placed in the very dangerous world where enemies are waiting just around the corner.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374028/7bd3e6b5e472739ef047ef04e666161704e3aa87.png[/img]

But the Energy has its benefits too. People learned how to collect and transform it for later use. It powers the great mining centers, the engines of high-tech ships, and can even serve as a shield for a restricted amount of time. That means you will hunt for the ancient creatures not only to survive but also to gather the most precious resource that will help you to fight your way through the game. There are other resources too but that’s something you will learn in the next devlogs ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374028/28b9d84a5582f3c5ad72bbb3ea9b9516ae6c232b.png[/img]

More about the game, its world, gameplay mechanics and what we are currently working on in the next devlogs.

Best!

notes.title: Underwater Space devlog #01
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374028/9d179ea38f68cfbf1c9e08d9e281bfb1dcc4c3c3.png[/img]

[b]Hello Aquanauts![/b]
After months of work on concept and preproduction we have finally reached the point when we can show you a gameplay video from Underwater Space game. So hold on and watch carefully our first video in devlog series, focused around the feeling of underwater space exploration:

[previewyoutube=Oa1I0sQgq3Q;full][/previewyoutube]

Please keep in mind that the game is totally work in progress right now, so every piece of it is subject to change. Especially UI which serves as a placeholder for the time being. But on the other side we are pleased with how the game looks so a general feeling of the visuals probably will stay the same for the rest of the development.


[b]Feeling of the unknown[/b]
The game takes place in deep waters. Almost the entire world looks like this after some unfortunate events we will talk about later on. You may recognize some structures from modern civilization but most of what you’ll see will be strangely new.
We encourage you to explore every inch of the underwater space. Set yourself for a journey in caves scattered everywhere, waiting to be visited. Find new species swimming around peacefully. Come closer to plants never seen before by a human… But be careful. There are rumours of monsters hiding near the bottom somewhere, hunting unprepared wanderers. Even some of the smaller fishes seem bizarre, like they possessed some kind of power that is too strong for them to hold inside. Should you explore that too...?

We hope you enjoyed this little sneak peak from us. More about the game, its world and gameplay mechanics in the next devlogs.

Best!
